body.value: Re-reading of E49: the word after Katherina appears sollempni[a?], not sollempnitas; it is followed by suscipiat alacriter pia ma[...]. The image is lower-resolution, the reading is reference-exposed and requires independent palaeographic verification. The chant identification is provisional.

annotations.literal_candidate: Inclita sancte uirginis / katherine sollempni[a?] suscipiat alacriter pia ma[...]
annotations.normalized_candidate: Inclita sanctae virginis Katherinae sollemnia suscipiat alacriter pia ma[...]
annotations.observer: Codex AI, reference-exposed re-reading, 2026-11-02; model checkpoint unavailable
interpretation_limits: Reading is provisional and based on the existing 1000-pixel image; higher-resolution request failed DNS.
The abbreviated end of ma[...] is not supplied and no independent reader or manuscript original has confirmed this reading.
This corrects a local transcription and does not establish a manuscript relationship or scholarly novelty.
